title: Evidence-First Narrative and Attack Story Builder
goal: Build narrative report and attack-story generation that can only cite finding IDs, runner output IDs, approval event IDs, evidence graph hypotheses, and stored graph edges. Missing evidence must produce an explicit gap, not a persuasive unsupported story.
scope: Narrative reports, attack stories, evidence graph, and operator trust.
generation_reason: AI report value should come from evidence-grounded storytelling, not generic prose or hallucinated attack chains.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Narratives must remain evidence-bound and must use controlled proof, canary evidence, and session exposure risk language unless ROE confirms a higher tier.

success_criteria: Every narrative bullet links to a finding ID, runner output ID, approval event ID, graph hypothesis ID, or graph edge ID.
Unsupported attack-story steps are rendered as gaps or hypotheses, not findings.
Reports show a source ledger that operators can audit from narrative sentence to stored evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Report narrative output includes a source ledger for each claim.
A fixture with missing evidence produces explicit gaps.
No narrative text claims proof without linked source IDs.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Generic AI prose without evidence IDs
Claiming exploitation beyond confirmed ROE tier
